name: AWS Cloud Security Assessment
description: Configuration review and attack-path testing of an AWS environment.

cases.title: Root account usage, MFA and access keys
IAM users without MFA and stale access keys
Overly permissive IAM policies and privilege escalation paths
cases.description: iam:PassRole, policy version abuse, wildcard actions.

cases.title: Cross-account trust and external IDs on assumable roles
S3 buckets with public access or permissive policies
Secrets in user data, environment variables and Lambda configuration
Security groups exposing management ports to 0.0.0.0/0
CloudTrail enabled in all regions with log integrity validation
Encryption at rest and KMS key policies
EKS/ECS cluster access and workload identity
